name: sdk-21-signal-already-aborted
what: The caller's AbortSignal has already fired when runStreamed() is called: what the SDK throws, and that the stub left no record. That is NOT evidence that the program is never started: see `corrected`.

corrected.earlierReading: `child` is null below, which was read as 'the program is never started'
corrected.whatIsSo: Node starts the process (it is given a process id) and ends it on the next turn of its loop, before the stub can write its record; seen on Windows and on Linux by watching ChildProcess.prototype.spawn. The error thrown is the one recorded below.
corrected.forTheRustEngine: look at the stop before starting the program, and do not start it

programAfterTheError.note: the stub would have run for sleepMsBeforeExit more; its heartbeat (ms since it started, every 20 ms) stopped at

abort.note: abortedAtMs and iterationEndedAtMs are since runStreamed() was called; the stub's two values are on its own clock (ms since it started), written every 20 ms
